tools.name: get_help
tools.description: Checks a parent's message for signs it needs urgent help (emergency, poison, fever in a young baby, breathing, self-harm and similar) and returns who to call and the reviewed warning signs for each stage. Call it first whenever a message mentions a symptom, an injury, something swallowed, or a paren

tools.name: search_guides
tools.description: Finds the reviewed Cradle guides that best match a parenting question (pregnancy, babies, toddlers, preschoolers and family life). Returns each guide's id, title, summary and page link, plus its when-to-call line. Also flags an urgent question the same way get_help does. Read a result in full with r

tools.name: read_guide
tools.description: Returns one guide in full as markdown: its sections, when to call, any data tables, its sources and page link.

tools.name: list_guides
tools.description: Lists every guide (id, title, topic, summary, link), grouped by stage: pregnancy, newborn, baby, toddler, preschool, family.

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "get_help" stacks urgency/override words (urgent, warning). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.
